constraints.text: Each requirement has ID, source reference and origin classification.

Users review and modify requirements and assumptions.

Requested, inferred, recommended, assumed and out-of-scope content are distinct.

requirements.title: Data, Integration, and AI Solution Strategy

requirements.title: Change Impact, Traceability, and Quality Validation

constraints.text: A reviewed change identifies affected outputs.
Quality gate identifies gaps and inconsistencies.
